tools.name: notifications_recent
tools.title: Recent notifications
tools.description: The latest notifications the user has had on this desktop, newest first: app, summary, body and time (ISO 8601), and whether Do Not Disturb is on (dnd). left_out counts the notifications the user's Access keeps from Claude (some apps', Mail's of mail it blocks): don't look for them another way. Use it when the user asks what they missed, or what a notification said.

tools.name: notifications_send
tools.title: Send a notification
tools.description: Show the user a notification on this desktop, from Claude: a reminder or a result they should see when they look up ("tell me when the build is done"). It stays in the notification history; the same text again replaces it instead of adding another. Do Not Disturb hides the popup but not the row.

body.description: The text under it, a sentence or two

tools.name: notifications_dnd_on
tools.title: Turn Do Not Disturb on
tools.description: Turn Do Not Disturb on: notifications stop popping up and chiming (they still go into the history), and the popups on screen now go. It hides alerts, so the user allows it on Nightdrive's card: turn it on only when the user asked to. notifications_recent shows whether it's on.

tools.name: notifications_dnd_off
tools.title: Turn Do Not Disturb off
tools.description: Turn Do Not Disturb off: notifications pop up and chime again. notifications_recent shows whether it's on.
